title: Three Distinct Cycling Logo Options
tests: Produces exactly three separately usable logo variations with distinct concepts and consistent required wording.

faults.what: All three options are black on white with no visible green, omitting an explicitly requested brand color.
The route symbol in image 2 has uneven, tapering lines and an awkward central junction, making it less clean and reproducible than the other symbols.

judge.summary: Three separate, readable and genuinely different logo options were delivered, but all omit the requested green.

must_haves.item: Exactly three separate square logo images are delivered.
must_haves.why: Three individual square images are shown, not a collage.

must_haves.item: Each logo clearly reads 'Moss & Mile', including the ampersand.
must_haves.why: The complete name and ampersand are legible and correctly spelled in every image.

must_haves.item: Each option includes a small symbol alongside or above the name.
must_haves.why: A wheel appears above the first name, a winding route beside the second, and an MM monogram above the third.

must_haves.item: The three options have visibly different symbol or layout concepts, rather than only color changes.
must_haves.why: The wheel, winding route, and monogram are distinct concepts, with additional differences in typography and text layout.

must_haves.item: All three use green and black on plain white backgrounds without mockup scenes or option labels.
must_haves.why: The backgrounds are plain white and have no scenes or option labels, but none of the logos visibly uses green.
